aka: What Is Seen Through a Keyhole
this_title: Par le trou de la serrure
trans_title: What Is Seen Through a Keyhole
introduction: As a janitor is cleaning a hotel, he decides to peek through the keyholes to observe some of the guests in their rooms. In room 8, a woman is busy making herself look more attractive, and the janitor enjoys watching her. There are also some interesting things going on in the other rooms on the floor. But the janitor soon finds out that there are also some drawbacks to what he is doing.
